'''Tas-Zvel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he resided in the city of [[Voss-Ka]] on [[Voss]], where he provided teaching to [[Jedi Consular]]s.<ref name="SW:TOR" />
